messages:
maria: Heads-up: I’m seeing slow memory growth on long-context LLM runs for 64k sessions, looks related to KV cache not releasing pages. Sample from last hour: kvcache_resident_pages_total = 4.2M, kvcache_evictions_total = 120, memory_rss = +1.1GB over 30m.
jin: ugh. can you paste the query you used?
maria: prom query I ran: 
```
sum by(pool) (kvcache_resident_pages_total{env="prod"})

sum by(pool) (increase(kvcache_evictions_total{env="prod"}[1h]))
```
And also checked per-shard residency: shard-3 is the main offender.
oscar: interesting that evictions are nonzero but residency still grows. could be fragmentation or stale references (ghost pages). any per-page-size histograms?
maria: no histogram exposed yet. We only have resident_pages, evictions and hit_rate. hit_rate for these sessions stays ~0.92 so not a pure miss storm.
jin: possible scenario: KV pages get appended but never compacted because reuse pattern keeps different offsets live across long contexts -> page churn but not evicted due to residency ceiling being high. need eviction-age counter.
oscar: we should add counters: kvcache_page_last_access_age_seconds {quantiles}, kvcache_fragmentation_ratio, kvcache_orphan_pages_total. Also an eviction-reason label for kvcache_evictions_total (age|pressure|manual).
maria: agreed. also noticed our current dashboard only shows hit rate and total residency; it's blind to page reuse patterns. link: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/kv/kv-residency-overview (mock)
jin: +1 on eviction-reason. We can derive age from last_access_ts but that requires hooking into observer. I'll open a small change to emit last_access_age gauge every minute for hot pages.
/devops-bot: deploy queued by jin:kv-age-metrics -> staging (sha: a1b2c3) :package:
tess: for the short term can we create an alert on residency growth slope? e.g., if resident_pages increases >200k over 15m for a pool that's usually stable.
oscar: yes. but threshold needs per-model baseline. Maybe anomaly detection on rate-of-change vs 24h rolling mean.
maria: action items: 
- jin to add kvcache_page_last_access_age_seconds gauge and eviction_reason label (PR by EOD)
- oscar to sketch fragmentation metric + dashboard tiles
- tess to add residency-slope alert prototype
jin: opening PR now, will ping here when staged.
oscar: quick debug tip: for reproducing locally, run long-context replay harness with --kv-hint=hot and profile with `kv_profiler --sample-pages 1%` to catch ghost pages.
maria: ran that locally; profiler output showed many pages with last_access > 2h but still resident. logged sample to /tmp/kv-ghosts-2026-03-18.log
tess: thanks. can we add an ephemeral dashboard to workspace for triage and put runbook steps? I'll create and link once done.
jin: staging deploy succeeded, metrics emitting in staging under `kvcache.page_last_access_age_seconds` (small sample).
oscar: once we have the gauge we can plot age distribution and tune eviction policy to prefer age>threshold compaction.
maria: linking kernel/batching note: if we force more aggressive batching then KV reuse drops which might reduce ghost pages but increases latency. need to measure tradeoff.
tess: raising a follow-up: coordinate with eng-runtime on rollout plan for eviction-reason labels so SLO dashboards don't spike false positives.
oscar: agreed. Also want to add a small profiler hook to capture fragmentation snapshot at OOM-like growth for retrospective analysis.
maria: thanks everyone. ping me if you see stage metrics. I'll attach the local log to the ticket.
